notes: NEW ZOMBIES MAP: TERMINAL 9 - story chapter three, FLIGHT 909. An airport cargo terminal with baggage chutes to fast-travel, the plane's cargo hold, 7 new chapters, 12 tapes and a boss in an expensive suit.
WONDER WEAPONS: one per zombies map - THE BONG CANNON, THE PRESSURE GUN and THE CROP DUSTER. Rare from the mystery crate, and your reward for finishing each story.
ZOMBIES POWER-UPS (RE-UP, HOTBOX, DOUBLE BAG, KUSH BOMB, THE FIXER, 420 SALE) and WALL STASHES - guns behind purple stencils you can buy off the wall.

NEW ZOMBIES: STRAY ROUNDS (junkie dogs every 5th round), FIENDS that crawl, BLOATERS that burst into smoke, and BARRICADED WINDOWS to board back up. Zombies stats per map, and a ZOMBIES tab on the friends leaderboard.
NEW MODE: BAGGED UP (kill confirmed) - everyone drops a stash bag when they die. Bag enemy bags to score, save your team's. Offline, online and private matches.
NEW MODE: TURF WAR (domination) - take and hold three grow spots, A, B and C. Offline, online and private matches.
KILLCAM: see your death over your killer's shoulder (turn it off in Settings).
4 NEW SCORESTREAKS: DEALER DRONE, SMOKE OUT (counter-UAV), TRAP HOUSE TURRET and HIGH FLYER (gunship).

WEEKLY CHALLENGES: THE PLUG'S LIST - six new jobs every Monday for XP and DZ, and a free PRESTIGE box for doing all six. PRESTIGE: at level 100 go back to level 1 and keep everything - 10 prestiges, each with an emblem, calling card, DZ and a box, plus 3 new finishes.
THE STASH YARD: a firing range and tutorial on the main menu.
FASTER FIRST LOAD, COLOUR-BLIND MODES (Settings > GAMEPLAY) and an ADS FIELD OF VIEW option (Settings > VIDEO).
BETTER ZOMBIES VOICES: the best voices your computer has, gentler pitch, and a VOICE LINES SPEED slider.
